notes.title: DESTRUCTIVE CREATIONS IS 10 YEARS OLD! 🥳
notes.content:
As part of our celebrations, we've chronicled the DC history and showcased new development and publishing projects currently in the works ⤵️
[previewyoutube=Mu8kJrtffGc;full][/previewyoutube]It might not be as fun as watching a cat fail compilation or your wedding video, featuring your favorite drunk uncle, but it’s light and fun whether you’re a DC fan, a DC hater (cheers to you!) or yet indifferent, but curious! 🎉🎉🎉
[hr][/hr]Starting today, you can also try the DEMO of our upcoming 63 DAYS title! 😎
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/ Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?

notes.title: Try to survive waiting for the premiere!
notes.content:
What's the best way to pass the time while waiting for the release of Shame Legacy? 🤔
Getting into the mood with the other survival horror we've published - Daymare 1998!

Before you step into the XIX century mysterious village, try to survive a deadly virus in the late '90s! ☣️

[previewyoutube=nHBILjqd3MQ;full][/previewyoutube]

As one of the few survivors, you'll need to fight your way through hordes of infected creatures while uncovering the dark secrets of the outbreak. With its immersive storyline, challenging gameplay, and heart-stopping scares, Daymare 1998 will keep you entertained for hours on end.

Best of all, the game is currently available at an incredible discount. 🤑 Don't hesitate and try it now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/842100/Daymare_1998/
